##### Project general facts

Whitestone Residences by Axiom Prime Real Estate is a boutique residential tower that combines elegant architecture with contemporary design. A facade with golden louvres on the balconies creates a warm, distinctive character, while terraces offer panoramic views of the city and a sunken garden brings greenery into the urban setting. The building rises above a ground floor and two parking levels to eight residential floors and a roof, offering studios, junior and executive one-bedroom apartments and two-bedroom homes.

Life at the building is elevated by a curated collection of rooftop amenities. A fitness centre with panoramic city views turns workouts into inspiring experiences, while an infinity pool, a dip pool, a sky lounge and outdoor dining spaces provide a stylish setting for relaxing and entertaining. A barbecue area, a fireside lounge and a children's play area complete the shared offer, supported by smart access control and round-the-clock security for residents and their guests.

Interiors are designed with careful attention to detail, combining wooden flooring, warm finishes and large windows with signature louvres that fill each home with soft natural light. Spacious layouts balance comfort and practicality, creating modern and welcoming living spaces. Kitchens are fully fitted with premium appliances, and homes are delivered with fitted kitchens only, leaving furniture and decor to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Garden City is a central residential district between Al Satwa and Sheikh Zayed Road, combining modern apartment buildings with the long-established neighbourhoods of Al Satwa and Al Wasl. Local markets, cafes, restaurants and supermarkets give the area a lively, authentic character, while quiet internal streets offer a calm retreat close to the busiest business and leisure districts of the city.

Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Wasl Road and Al Satwa Road connect residents with the wider city, and several metro stations are within easy reach. The Dubai International Financial Centre, City Walk and Emirates Towers are a short drive away, while Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, Jumeirah Beach and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable driving distance.

Jumeirah Garden City is a freehold area open to international buyers and one of the few central locations in Dubai offering accessible entry prices. Proximity to the main business districts, metro access and a vibrant urban setting attract young professionals and short-stay guests, supporting high occupancy. Boutique buildings with rooftop amenities underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for investors.
